instructions: Calm, clear, warm American female teacher. Steady medium pace, friendly and unhurried. A short pause before each number. Plain American English.

scenes.vo: An SBA 7(a) loan is a bank loan the U.S. Small Business Administration partly guarantees. New rules for buying a business took effect October first, twenty twenty-six.
scenes.caption: An SBA 7(a) loan is a bank loan the U.S. Small Business Administration partly guarantees. New rules for buying a business took effect October 1, 2026.

scenes.vo: The core rule: ten percent of the project cost must come in as equity, money alongside the loan. That's the equity injection, and for a first acquisition it can't be reduced or eliminated.
scenes.caption: The core rule: 10% of the project cost must come in as equity, money alongside the loan. That's the equity injection, and for a first acquisition it can't be reduced or eliminated.

scenes.vo: At least five percent, half of it, must come from your own resources, such as cash that isn't borrowed.
scenes.caption: At least 5%, half of it, must come from your own resources, such as cash that isn't borrowed.

scenes.vo: The other five percent can be a seller note, but only on full standby for the life of the loan. That means the seller gets no payments on it until the bank loan is repaid.
scenes.caption: The other 5% can be a seller note, but only on full standby for the life of the loan. That means the seller gets no payments on it until the bank loan is repaid.

scenes.vo: A bigger seller note, not on full standby, must be covered by cash flow in the DSCR test. That's the debt service coverage ratio: cash flow divided by loan payments, at least one point two five times.
scenes.caption: A bigger seller note, not on full standby, must be covered by cash flow in the DSCR test. That's the debt service coverage ratio: cash flow divided by loan payments, at least 1.25x.

scenes.vo: Investors can fund part of the ten percent too, as minority owners. Until the loan is repaid, they can take only tax distributions.
scenes.caption: Investors can fund part of the 10% too, as minority owners. Until the loan is repaid, they can take only tax distributions.

scenes.vo: An illustrative two million dollar purchase. The bank loan covers ninety percent: one million eight hundred thousand dollars. Your own cash is five percent: one hundred thousand. A standby seller note is the last five percent: one hundred thousand.
scenes.caption: An illustrative $2,000,000 purchase. The bank loan covers 90%: $1,800,000. Your own cash is 5%: $100,000. A standby seller note is the last 5%: $100,000.

scenes.vo: Every lender has its own appetite, so confirm with your lender. The new SBA rules for buying a business.
scenes.caption: Every lender has its own appetite, so confirm with your lender. The new SBA rules for buying a business.
